how_the_event_graph_is_read: UEdGraph.Nodes is protected and AnimationBlueprintLibrary.GetNodesOfClass refuses anything that is not an AnimGraphNode, so neither of those is the door. BlueprintEditorLibrary.find_event_graph returns the graph and unreal.find_object(graph, name) returns a node inside it. Variable setters are found by scanning K2Node_VariableSet_N, and each is walked back through its input pins to the literals it is computed from. That is how the 375 cm/s gait threshold below was read out of the asset for the first time. See issue #430.
the_flipped_boolean_sense: A Blend Poses by bool node puts the TRUE pose on pin index 0 and the FALSE pose on pin 1, which is the opposite of how the node reads top to bottom. Both of ABP_Brute's were wired backwards on the strength of that. See issue #408.
what_this_is: Written by tools/read_animation_graph.py. What is wired to what inside each animation Blueprint, and the SHA-256 of the asset it was read from. tools/tests/test_animation_graph_reading_is_current.py fails when an asset has changed since. Regenerate with python tools/run_editor_python.py tools/read_animation_graph.py
